title: Reference approach: Large-Array Performance Lab
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Benchmark equivalent vectorized and iterative work.
Inspect dtype, nbytes, strides, contiguity, views, and copies.
Try chunked or memory-mapped processing where appropriate.
Report repeated measurements and avoid unsupported performance claims.
explanation: Compare alternative implementations and document speed/memory trade-offs on representative arrays. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
